verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gitea Actions provides CI/CD with workflows written in a familiar YAML format, compatible with GitHub Actions, and that existing Actions can be reused. That covers the core of defining pipelines as YAML code. The older community remark that Gitea avoids bundling CI predates this and is not a concrete hands-on failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed workflow syntax documentation, evidence on runner setup and execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions working in practice.
